headline: Public hearing on a nine-unit residential building at 101 and 105 Winter Street; workshop on a zoning change for a stadium at 92 Cassidy Point Drive.
summary: The Hearts of Pine, LLC request asks to rezone part of the 92 Cassidy Point Drive parcel from Waterfront Port Development to B-5 Urban Commercial. The 105 Winter LLC project spans parts of the RN-4 Neighborhood Residential and B-3 Downtown Business zones.
items: Workshop on a map and text zoning amendment at 92 Cassidy Point Drive, Hearts of Pine, LLC, applicant: rezone part of the parcel to B-5 Urban Commercial and allow stadiums in the B-5 zone
Report of decisions on 43 Saint Lawrence Street, Major Site Plan PL-003653-2026: approved 6-0
Report of decisions on 76 Congress Street, Condition Zoning Agreement Amendment ZN-003712-2206: recommended to Council with a 10-year time limit, 6-0
Public hearing on a Major Site Plan at 101 and 105 Winter Street, 105 Winter LLC, applicant: five-unit and four-unit residential buildings, nine units total, 13 parking spaces, PL-003623-2026
location: Room 24, Basement Level of City Hall, and Zoom

PUBLIC COMMENT INFORMATION: 
To submit written public comment on an agenda item, email planningboard@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions 
must be received by 12:00 pm the day before the Planning Board meeting to guarantee their inclusion in the 
agenda packet. All submissions must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help ensure your 
comment is submitted for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below). 
 
 
AGENDA: 
 
    
WORKSHOP - 4:30 PM 
    
i. Map and Text Zoning Amendment; 92 Cassidy Point Drive; Hearts of Pine, LLC, Applicant. The 
Planning Board will hold a workshop to consider a zoning amendment application to rezone a portion 
of the parcel at 92 Cassidy Point Drive from Waterfront Port Development zone (WPDZ) to B-5 Urban 
Commercial zone. The Applicant is also seeking a text amendment to allow “stadiums” as a permitted 
use in the B-5 zone to facilitate the construction of a stadium. A project and plan summary are 
available for viewing on the city’s CSS Portal (https://css.portlandmaine.gov/) by referencing Plan 
Number ZN-003675-2026. 
    
PUBLIC HEARING - 5:30 PM 
    
1. ROLL CALL AND DECLARATION OF QUORUM 
2. COMMUNICATION AND REPORTS 
3. REPORT OF ATTENDANCE AT THE MEETING HELD ON OCTOBER 27, 2026 
  Public Hearing 
43 St. Lawrence Street: Din, Robertson, Silk, Smith, Uhlenhake, and Zamboni. Messina absent.  
76 Congress Street: Din, Robertson, Silk, Smith, Uhlenhake, and Zamboni. Messina absent.  
4. REPORTS OF DECISIONS AT THE MEETING HELD ON OCTOBER 27, 2026 
  i. 43 Saint Lawrence Street; PL-003653-2026; Major Site Plan; St Lawrence Development LLC, 
Applicant. Robertson motioned, and Uhlenhake seconded a motion to approve the site plan 
application. Vote 6-0 (Messina absent). Robertson motioned, and Uhlenhake seconded a 
motion to adopt the findings contained in the October 27, 2026 staff report and draft approval 
letter, and to authorize the Board Chair to sign the approval letter as drafted. Vote 6-0 (Messina 
absent).   
76 Congress Street; ZN-003712-2206; Condition Zoning Agreement Amendment; The Hill 
Arts/Friends of the St. Lawrence Church, Applicant. Robertson motioned, and Uhlenhake 
seconded a motion to recommend to the Council adoption of the conditional zoning agreement 
amendment with a further amendment to add a 10-year time limit to the conditional zoning 
agreement. Vote 6-0 (Messina absent).   
5. NEW BUSINESS 
  i. Major Site Plan; 105 Winter Street; 105 Winter LLC, Applicant. The Planning Board will hold 
a public hearing to consider a Major Site Plan application at 101 & 105 Winter Street to 
facilitate the construction of a five-unit residential building and a four-unit residential building, 
for a total of nine units, with 13 parking spaces. The subject property is split between the RN-4 
Neighborhood Residential and B-3 Downtown Business zones. A project and plan summary are 
available for viewing on the city’s CSS Portal (https://css.portlandmaine.gov/) by referencing 
Plan Number PL-003623-2026.
